contradictions.description: BILL-3145 and the June bank statement report Ridgeline Telecom at $8,253.00, while the general ledger records both the utility expense and cash payment at $8,523.00. This is a $270.00 GL error, although the authoritative bill and bank clearing amount make the required correction determinable.

The 2026-06-30 AP aging totals $30,801.00, but the trial balance reports Accounts Payable of $49,903.43, leaving an unexplained $19,102.43 difference. This appears to be the residual opening payable balance, but no vendor-level aging support is provided for it.

w30-accrual_schedule.reason: The May prepaid schedule and insurance contract define the prepaid population and support June amortization of $76.00; the GL confirms June amortization has not yet been booked.

w30-bank_rec.reason: The statement arithmetic ties, all bank and book reconciling items can be identified, and the BILL-3145 document plus bank clearing amount resolves the $270 GL error.

w30-journal_entries.reason: The files support a June payroll accrual, one insurance amortization entry, and the BILL-3148 expense reclassification; June depreciation is already posted and bank-side corrections are expressly excluded.

w30-variance_analysis.reason: June GL activity, budget data, payroll accrual, prepaid amortization, posted depreciation, and supported vendor-bill reclasses are sufficient to calculate as-closed actuals and explain material variances using professional judgment.
